* IkeMac is an abstract class that represents common information for all negotiated algorithms that
 * generates Message Authentication Code (MAC), e.g. PRF and integrity algorithm.

methods.name: public byte[] signBytes(byte[] keyBytes, byte[] dataToSign)
methods.comment:
* Signs the bytes to generate a Message Authentication Code (MAC). * *

Caller is responsible for providing valid key according to their use cases (e.g. PSK, * SK_p, SK_d ...). * * @param keyBytes the key to sign data. * @param dataToSign the data to be signed. * @return the calculated MAC.

methodNames: public byte[] signBytes(byte[] keyBytes, byte[] dataToSign)
